title: Eldridge Triple P’s
body: Formed: April 2017Members: 21GOAL: “To grow our club with active youths, under great leadership and support, as we strive to create an eco-friendly community.”VISION: “To use what we have and create change and positive impact on our community”Eldridge ville Triple P’s:Protect – environmentPreserve – reservePrevent – pollutionPresidents: Stephanie Ramclam & Reecie MutrieVice President: Venice ParhamMAJOR ACCOMPLISHMENTS:1) Conducted numerous clean-ups in Eldridge and the coastline.2.) Participated in TIDE’s Volleyball Competition during REEF week and are Runner Up Champions.3.) Attended Family Violence Sessions with the Productive Organization for Women in Action (POWA).Feel free to send us a message if you are interested in joining the Eldridge Triple P’s or are searching for an opportunity to volunteer within the Toledo District.
